purpose: Define an employment contract/continuing work relationship as a long-running composite Project whose recurring periods and concrete tasks are child Projects rather than a separate employment-work primitive.

topics.name: Recurring Employment Project
topics.purpose: Define an employment contract/continuing work relationship as a long-running composite Project whose recurring periods and concrete tasks are child Projects rather than a separate employment-work primitive.

semantics.model_rule: Employment relationship is represented as a Project.
semantics.duration_rule: Employment Project may be long-running/open-ended according to explicit contract semantics.
semantics.recurrence_rule: Recurring work periods may be represented as child Projects, typically week-by-week where that matches the relationship.
semantics.task_rule: Concrete tasks/work packages remain child/leaf Projects.
semantics.identity_rule: Employer/worker identities and roles are explicit Project relations.
semantics.merit_rule: Merit evidence attaches to actual Project work/outcomes, not merely existence/duration of employment relationship.
semantics.portfolio_rule: PortfolioCore may reference the employment Project as work-history evidence.

invariants.rule: Project is the universal recursive work primitive; task-like semantics are represented by Projects rather than parallel task entities.

hard_gates.condition: employer/worker identities inferred only from prose

references.purpose: Employment uses the universal Project primitive.

prose.summary: Define an employment contract/continuing work relationship as a long-running composite Project whose recurring periods and concrete tasks are child Projects rather than a separate employment-work primitive.
